description: This file contains utility functions for managing SQS streams within the Orleans AWS streaming provider, including a method to delete all used queues for a specific provider and cluster.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing SQS queues related to Orleans streaming.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes all queues associated with a given provider and cluster ID by initiating queue deletion tasks.
